binding_object: the FORMULA; any numeric cap is derived, never frozen independently
formula: CAP = ceil_50(1.15*(P + INFL + RETRY + OVH)); P = 1.10*N*c_max; R = ceil_0.5(1.25*c_max); INFL = W*R; RETRY = 0.03*N*R; OVH = 0.02*P

parameters.W: physical cores of the bound host used as workers (rebaseguard-vultr-02: 4)
parameters.c_max: worst measured CPU-h per cell on the bound host, from the frozen qualification protocol

reserve_evidence.RETRY_3pct: PS1 generation-1 infrastructure tear loss 92.32 / 5694 CPU-h = 1.62%; frozen tear limit 3 per cell
reserve_evidence.no_shape_factor: Aux4 and the qualification both measure one worker per physical core

rules: computed from the qualification measurement before production
a change of host, runtime contract or producer identity requires requalification and recomputation
